'Action - Destroy this: Banish the top 2 cards of your deck. Gain 1 action point for each Mechanologist card banished this way.' ACTIVATE equipment ability (offered by play._add_hero_dsl_activations); the destroy is the ability COST (cost_types.py DESTROY_PERMANENT target 'self' resolves the legs slot), not an effect. activation_cost 0 explicit: no {r} in the text.

LOOK_AT player SELF is explicit -- the handler defaults to OPPONENT. amount 2 stores a LIST in the ref; BANISH_REF iterates it. from_zone 'deck' is REQUIRED: LOOK_AT peeks without moving, and the BANISH_REF handler comment warns that without an origin zone banish() adds to the banished zone while leaving the card in the deck (present in both at once).

'banished this way': COUNT_REF over the same ref equals the banished set because BANISH_REF unconditionally banishes everything stored; class filter uses the 'class' key (handler reads card_class or class, matching against classes+talents -- Mechanologist is a class). Fewer than 2 cards in deck: LOOK_AT stores the shorter list and every step degrades gracefully.

Battleworn is in printed_keywords and comes from the card DB keywords field; deliberately NOT authored here.
